CICS.modernization_pattern: isolate transaction and program boundary before service extraction
CICS.required_development_evidence: transaction contract, candidate, side-effect comparator, and negative tests
CICS.required_live_evidence: authorized CICS transaction, installed-resource, and side-effect capture

COBOL.modernization_pattern: preserve record and call contracts while extracting executable behavior
COBOL.required_development_evidence: behavior oracle, candidate, differential comparison, and mutation tests
COBOL.required_live_evidence: authorized compiled original execution with input, output, and side-effect capture

Configuration.modernization_pattern: classify ownership and deployment semantics before translating or consolidating configuration
Configuration.required_development_evidence: typed configuration contract, consumer lineage, validation rules, and deployment tests
Configuration.required_live_evidence: authorized installed configuration, consumer binding, change history, and deployment observation

Db2.modernization_pattern: separate schema, query semantics, data movement, cutover, and recovery proofs
Db2.required_development_evidence: schema mapping, bounded fixtures, query checksums, CDC rehearsal, and rollback
Db2.required_live_evidence: authorized catalog, package, source-row, log, cutover, and rollback observation

HLASM.modernization_pattern: isolate calling convention and bit-level behavior behind a typed replacement boundary
HLASM.required_development_evidence: instruction subset, calling contract, oracle, candidate, and boundary mutations
HLASM.required_live_evidence: assembler and binder listings, load-module digest, and authorized caller execution

IMS.modernization_pattern: preserve DBD, PSB, PCB, status, checkpoint, and restart semantics
IMS.required_development_evidence: database contract, call sequence oracle, candidate, status and restart tests
IMS.required_live_evidence: authorized BMP region, DBD/PSB, database, status, checkpoint, restart, and JES evidence

JCL.modernization_pattern: translate job topology only after programs, datasets, conditions, and restart boundaries resolve
JCL.required_development_evidence: job-step DAG, condition semantics, dataset contract, restart plan, and scheduler candidate
JCL.required_live_evidence: authorized job execution, JES output, dataset effects, conditions, and restart capture

PL/I.modernization_pattern: preserve decimal, file, SQL, and cross-language calling semantics in a bounded cell
PL/I.required_development_evidence: source-faithful oracle, candidate, differential comparison, and semantic mutations
PL/I.required_live_evidence: Enterprise PL/I compile, Db2 bind, and authorized PL/I-to-COBOL execution

VSAM.modernization_pattern: preserve keyed access, record bytes, alternate indexes, locking, and recovery semantics
VSAM.required_development_evidence: catalog contract, byte fixtures, key-path comparator, concurrency and recovery tests
VSAM.required_live_evidence: authorized clusters, alternate indexes, record bytes, locking, and recovery observation
